newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Organon, Pherin in drug development deal.
newsitem.headline: Organon, Pherin in drug development deal.

text.p: Chemical group Akzo Nobel said on Monday its pharmaceuticals unit Organon had signed an agreement with Californian drugs company Pherin to develop and market medicines aimed at treating conditions such as anxiety and over-eating.
Akzo said the agreement covered the development and licensing of certain vomeropherins, a family of compounds discovered by Pherin which are said to mimic pheromones.
Pherin said its vomeropherins are administered nasally, enabling them to activate the centre of the brain which controls functions such as appetite and hormonal system.
Akzo declined to give any financial details of the deal, which it said would look into the possibilities for joint development of drugs based on the compounds.
